_about: Inputs for pricing/cost_model.py. 'providers' holds public list rates normalized to USD per decimal TB (10^12 bytes) per 730-hour month; each entry names its sources and retrieval date. 'assumptions' and 'plans' are ParaAir modeling choices, not provider facts. Last updated: 2026-10-09.

ovh_us_1az.label: OVH US Standard 1-AZ
ovh_us_1az.basis: $0.00001111 per GiB-hour x 730 h x 931.3226 GiB/TB; egress, API and retrieval free
ovh_us_1az.terms_status: ToS wording may restrict a file-hosting/similar service; needs written partner confirmation

ovh_us_two_region.label: OVH US, copy in 2 regions
ovh_us_two_region.basis: two full copies (Vint Hill + Hillsboro); US has no 3-AZ class

ovh_plus_b2_backup.label: OVH US + B2 backup copy
ovh_plus_b2_backup.basis: OVH primary serves reads; second full copy on B2 receives writes only

b2_direct.label: Backblaze B2, direct
b2_direct.basis: $6.95/TB per 30 days x 730/720 on byte-hours (decimal TB inferred); 3x average stored free, then $0.01/GB; Class A/B/C free
b2_direct.terms_status: Powered by Backblaze embedded program exists; pricing not published

b2_workers.label: B2 via Cloudflare Worker
b2_workers.basis: B2 egress to Cloudflare listed free; Workers Paid $0.30/M requests + $0.02/M CPU-ms beyond included; account $5 base in fixed costs; gateway authorizes with stateless signed read tokens from the file-index service, so no per-request state I/O is modeled
b2_workers.terms_status: Cloudflare CDN video/large-file clause applicability to a Worker proxy of B2 content unsettled

r2_standard.label: Cloudflare R2 Standard
r2_standard.basis: $0.015/GB-month (decimal GB per limits page); Class A $4.50/M, Class B $0.36/M; egress free
r2_standard.terms_status: self-serve terms restrict selling access to the Services; see provider-terms review

idrive_e2.label: IDrive e2 standard
idrive_e2.basis: $6/TB-month, 1 TB minimum; 3x allowance (base wording varies: active/total/plan capacity), then $0.01/GB
idrive_e2.terms_status: reseller program; pooling and minimum per sub-user not published

tigris_standard.label: Tigris Standard
tigris_standard.basis: $0.02/GB-month with 1 GB = 2^30 bytes; Class A $5/M, Class B $0.50/M; egress free
tigris_standard.terms_status: documented partner program at standard rates

hetzner_eu.label: Hetzner EU (marginal)
hetzner_eu.basis: marginal storage $0.0123 per TB-hour x 730; egress beyond base allowance $1.20/TB; EU locations only; base $7.99 cap is account-level

aws_s3_use1.label: AWS S3 Standard us-east-1
aws_s3_use1.basis: $0.023 per binary GB-month first 50 TB; internet egress $0.09 per binary GB first 10 TB; account-wide 100 GB free not allocated

assumptions._about: ParaAir modeling assumptions. None of these are measured customer statistics.

fixed._note: launch control plane + regional metadata HA + off-site metadata backups + monitoring + email + Workers base; assumption

assumptions._read_request_bytes: Target gateway/client read size (4 MiB, aligned to objects). Today's client reads 1 MiB blocks (Engine.swift blockSize default), which quadruples GET and Worker requests; see read_request_sensitivity.
assumptions._cohort_overhead: Recovery space outside quota is capped at 15% of plan capacity; oldest versions expire first.
